integrity: Self-contained proof, reproducible finite tests, explicit adaptive tree; finite tests support but do not establish all-order claims.
scientific_limitations: For finite n and k the exact Littlestone dimension is not given in general; fixed-positive-even-k asymptotics and an explicit finite first gap are proved.
The all-parameter theorem covers binary vertex labels with an exact feasible even number of cyclic switches, not other alphabets or at-most-k classes.
Uniform-matroid shellability is previously known; this result establishes that these particular learning complexes are uniform.
Historical priority is not independently certified; equivalents under cyclic arc or change-point terminology may exist.
title: Exact cyclic switch classes: uniform shattering, trace multiplicities, and logarithmic adaptive growth
